problems.detail: This plan should teach you to craft The Gutter, but it teaches The Gutter Paint instead. The Gutter's own crafting recipe (co_Weapon_Melee_DLC01_AssaultronBlade_TheGutter) was left behind: it no longer makes anything and it is unlocked by a deleted record (_DELETE_Note), so there is no way to learn to craft The Gutter. These game checks still look for that old recipe, so they can never pass: DailyOps_AllChaseRareRecipesKnown_Condition, MPE_AllChaseUltraRareRecipesKnown_Condition.
